title: Notch Audio Island & Multi-Media Player
brief: Interactive media pill and expanded detail HUD for macOS notch, supporting multi-app audio detection (Spotify, Web browsers, Ghostty terminal, etc.) with hover and click interactions.

artboards.title: Dynamic Island Card
artboards.tradeoff: Rich visual feedback, album artwork, and full transport controls; higher vertical footprint when expanded.

artboards.title: Integrated Winged HUD
artboards.tradeoff: Minimal vertical footprint hugging the menu bar; less room for large album art.

artboards.title: Multi-Source Audio Matrix
artboards.tradeoff: Direct control and volume mixing across multiple concurrent audio apps (Spotify, Terminal, Browser); denser UI.
